run.sql:

  (SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_year=2002 THEN sr.sr_return_amt END)/SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_year=2002 THEN ss.ss_net_paid END)

FROM store_sales ss
JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
  ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
 AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
WHERE (d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 6)
